description: List merge request diffs with pagination (merge_request_iid or source_branch required). For one known resource, use the matching get tool.

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

per_page.description: Number of items per page (max: 100, default: 20)

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project

summary.description: If true, return only high-signal fields (id, iid, title, state, web_url, …). Default false keeps the full GitLab JSON.

unidiff.description: Present diffs in the unified diff format. Default is false. Introduced in GitLab 16.5.

name: list_merge_request_diffs
